teaser: Gameweek 11 splits clean down the middle — a handful of teams get a soft touch, and some big names walk into a wall. Knowing which side your squad sits on is the whole game this week.
fullWriteup:
**Aston Villa**, **Man City**, **Coventry**, **Crystal Palace**, **Spurs** and **Brighton** all get a 2/5 this week — the kindest set on the board. The other end is uglier: **Fulham** have a 5/5 at the Etihad, while Forest, Leeds, Newcastle, Hull, Man United and Everton are all staring at 4/5. Liverpool v Man United and Chelsea v Leeds are the obvious watch-outs if you're leaning on the away sides.

**N.Jackson** is the standout. Form of **11.0** — the best in the game right now — and Villa are home to Sunderland on a 2/5. At £7.1m and 32.4% owned he's close to essential. **Van Hecke** (form 8.7, £5.1m) has Spurs at home to Ipswich on a 2/5, which is as good as a £5.1m defender gets. Brighton's **Verbruggen** and **Vuskovic** both carry 6.3 form into a 2/5 trip to Hull. Arsenal's **Konsa** (10.7) and **Gabriel** (10.3) are flying but go to Newcastle on a 3 — fine, not a gift.

For the differential, **Alysson** at £4.9m and **0.3% owned**. Form of 6.3 in the same Villa side that gets the Sunderland fixture, and at that price he's a cheap route into an attack that's scoring. If you want a safer punt, **Muharemović** at 6.5% ownership has form 7.3 — but Leeds at Chelsea is a 4/5, so that's a hold rather than a buy.
